narrative.overview: A well-kept account book: white pages, straight rules, figures that line up, and one blue pen for the things you act on. The interface earns trust by being quiet and predictable, so the numbers stand out, not the chrome.
keyCharacteristics: White working surfaces on a cool, quiet ground
One accent (Ledger Blue) for actions, selection, and focus
32px controls, 36px table rows, 6px control corners, 8px container corners
Flat at rest; shadows only on things that float
One typeface (Inter), with tabular figures wherever numbers must line up

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Ledger Blue marks what you can act on and what is selected. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Navy Border Rule
rules.body: Navy appears in the sidebar and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Components never contain hex values or rgba() literals.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing a user must read is smaller than 12px.

rules.name: The Title Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, headers, and menu items use Title Case in plain words. Never all-caps.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels, cards, and tables have a 1px border and no shadow. A hover never lifts or moves an element.

rules.name: The No Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: No colored left or right border on rows, cards, alerts, or list items.

rules.name: The Ink Amounts Rule
rules.body: Debit, credit, and balance amounts are all ink; only negative or out-of-balance values turn red.

dos: Do build every screen from PageHeader, .panel, data-table, and the shared fields and buttons.
Do right-align every amount, quantity, and count, with tabular figures.
Do mark required fields with * and validate before calling the API.
Do write labels, buttons, and headers in Title Case, in plain words a non-native English speaker understands.
Do take currency, date, timezone, and number formats from settings.
Do give every icon-only button an aria-label and a title.
Do check every change in both Light and Dark.
donts: Don't use gradients anywhere in the working UI.
Don't use navy or blue bars as panel or table headers.
Don't use uppercase labels or table headers.
Don't use font sizes below 12px, or weights outside 400–700.
Don't hardcode hex, rgba(), pixel radii, or font sizes in components; use tokens.
Don't put colored left or right stripes on rows, cards, or alerts.
Don't use a modal for create/edit of small records; use SidePanel.
Don't add pastel stat-card rows on list screens.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as icons; use Tabler icons at stroke 1.8.
Don't add new themes. Light and Dark only.
